tokens.name: leyline-orange
tokens.usage: End of the leyline gradient: the warm arrival, the pulse and the nodes. Brand fills, illustration. Not for text on light grounds (2.6:1 on white) — use warm.

tokens.name: leyline-magenta
tokens.usage: Midpoint of the leyline gradient. Brand fills and illustration.

tokens.name: leyline-sky
tokens.usage: Start of the leyline gradient: the cool source under the first letter. Brand fills, the cool wallpaper nodes; as text only on night grounds (8.8:1 on night-900).

tokens.name: leyline-sky-deep
tokens.usage: Deep sky for large brand blocks; white text on it is 4.1:1, so only 24px+ or bold 19px+.

tokens.name: leyline-orange-deep
tokens.usage: Outer rim of the node sphere and the light wallpaper's rays. Brand fills only.

tokens.name: node-glow
tokens.usage: Node halo on dark and transparent marks (used at 50–92% opacity), amber. Glow effects only; on white use node-glow-day.

tokens.name: node-glow-light
tokens.usage: Inner node halo on dark and transparent marks. Glow effects only; never on white.

tokens.name: node-glow-day
tokens.usage: Core of the ORANGE node halo used on white (the *-white marks: #FF9A3D fading through leyline-orange to transparent).

tokens.name: node-ice
tokens.usage: Highlight ring inside the warm node sphere. Glow effects, tiny accents on night grounds.

tokens.name: node-ray
tokens.usage: Thin warm lines in the wallpaper (low opacity).

tokens.name: node-cool
tokens.usage: Core of the cool (sky) wallpaper nodes.

tokens.name: night-950
tokens.usage: Wallpaper vignette edge; the deepest ground.

tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Wallpaper ground.

tokens.name: night-850
tokens.usage: Ground of the black logo card.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Ground of the black app icon and favicon; ink of the wordmark on white.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Wallpaper vignette centre.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Wordmark ink on night grounds.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Ground of the white logo card and white app icon.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: 1px hairline around the white app icon.

tokens.name: brand-ground
tokens.usage: Ground behind the logo, hero areas and splash screens: white in Light (as the white logo card), night in Dark (as the wallpaper).

tokens.name: brand-card
tokens.usage: Card that carries the logo lockup: leylines-logo-white in Light, leylines-logo-black in Dark.

tokens.name: wordmark-ink
tokens.usage: Ink of the wordmark in each mode, and of any lettering set beside the logo, on brand-ground or brand-card.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: App-icon and favicon tile: the white tile in Light, the black tile in Dark.

tokens.name: icon-tile-edge
tokens.usage: 1px edge of the icon tile: the mist hairline on white in Light; none (same as the tile) in Dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks, inset areas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers (not control borders).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; ≥3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All running text — headings, paragraphs, table cells, form values — on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken. In Light this is the brand black night-800 (#0C1120): text on white is black, never grey.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Small metadata only — captions, labels, timestamps, table headers, hints — on surface and surface-raised. Not for paragraphs: those stay in ink. Light value 9.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, links, active state; as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent text (selected rows, info notes).

tokens.name: warm
tokens.usage: Warm highlight text and icons on surface and surface-raised (light value darkened from leyline-orange for contrast).

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Magenta highlight text and icons on surface and surface-raised (values adjusted from leyline-magenta for contrast).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset, on every surface.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero lines, cover titles. One per view.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI, table cells, secondary copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls; between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding (vertical 8–12).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, default gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level spacing, hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small buttons, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels — the logo card's corner (16 on a 310-wide card).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large tiles and sheets — the app icon's corner at 100px (24/94).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, node-like dots, avatars.

tokens.name: glow-node
tokens.usage: Halo on a highlighted node or active marker. Dark: wide amber bloom, as on the black and transparent marks. Light: tighter orange halo, as on the white marks.

tokens.name: glow-cool
tokens.usage: Cool halo, as on the wallpaper's sky nodes. Sparingly.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Raised cards and menus.

tokens.name: leyline
tokens.usage: The leyline stroke: sky → magenta → orange, cool source to warm arrival. For the line motif and thin accents only, never as a page background.
